factcheck.claim: South Korea's K-pop album exports reached US$120 million in Q1 2026.
K-pop album exports increased 159% year over year in the January-March period.
Q1 2026 was the first quarter in which K-pop album exports exceeded US$100 million.
Quarterly exports have set consecutive records since Q3 2025.
The United States overtook Japan as the largest destination for K-pop album exports in Q1 2026.

factcheck.claim: Seoul Economic Daily reported the U.S. at 28.8% and Japan at 25.3%.
The European Union, China, and Taiwan followed with 16.5%, 14.4%, and 6.9% respectively.
K-pop albums were imported by 131 countries and 94 recorded their highest-ever quarterly imports.
